explication: pg-aiguide gives coding agents PostgreSQL expertise through MCP documentation search and installable skills. The main runtime path is an agent request entering the MCP server, dispatching a search or skill tool, and returning documentation results or curated guidance. A separate ingestion path scrapes PostgreSQL, PostGIS, and Tiger/Timescale documentation, chunks and embeds it, then stores searchable records. Source excerpts establish core call relationships; skill availability and remote MCP usage are documented in the README, while some ingestion-stage wiring is supported only by the SOURCE INDEX.
